primary_question: Does one-epoch LoRA SFT improve Qwen3.5-9B's ability to make rare, high-confidence ADP overrides without creating excessive false interventions?

generation.system_prompt: You are a conservative fantasy-football draft decision policy. Choose KEEP_ADP unless the visible evidence strongly supports one listed alternative. Return only compact JSON matching one of these schemas: {"decision":"KEEP_ADP"} or {"decision":"OVERRIDE","candidate_id":"B000"}.

success_gates.product_safety: adapter mean points above ADP must be at least -5 and adapter catastrophes may not exceed the untouched base
success_gates.product_upside: reported separately; strongest result is positive mean and trimmed mean versus ADP, but it is not required to claim behavioral learning

interpretation_rules: No prompt, decoding, threshold, checkpoint, or corpus changes after opening the 2025 holdout.
The 2021-2022 panel is provisional because it was already opened; it is not fresh heldout proof.
The 2013 result remains an out-of-distribution historical stress-test failure and is never removed from reporting.
A format-only improvement is not a product win unless teacher agreement or roster outcomes also improve.
The deterministic teacher remains the production fallback if the adapter fails any safety gate.
